units.title: Math, data and tensor bridge
units.objective: Explain and implement the path from Python/NumPy data to PyTorch tensor shape, dtype, elementary operations and one small autograd example.

exercise.summary: Create a CPU-only script that transforms a small numeric table into tensors, reports shape/dtype, performs documented operations and verifies one hand-computed gradient.

project_task.summary: Trace every shape and operation in a deterministic local tensor calculation without GPU or downloaded data.

acceptance: The learner explains scalar, vector, matrix, axis, shape and dtype in the submitted example.
NumPy and PyTorch results agree for the selected elementary operation.
One autograd gradient matches a hand calculation within an explicit tolerance.
The run uses a fixed local fixture and records library versions.

triggers: Tensor/autograd APIs used by the exercise change
Learner evidence exposes an unbridged prerequisite

limitations: Content readiness and a reference script do not prove learner mastery.
This beginner bridge does not cover optimization, neural networks, Transformers or GPU execution.

units.title: Reproducible model and evaluation fundamentals
units.objective: Build and evaluate one simple local baseline with fixed data/split/config, explicit metric semantics, leakage checks and reproducibility limitations.

exercise.summary: Evaluate a simple CPU baseline on a bundled toy dataset using a fixed split and metric, then deliberately demonstrate and correct one leakage mistake.

project_task.summary: Replay the evaluation twice and distinguish exact code/data/config reproducibility from general model quality.

acceptance: Data split, preprocessing boundary, seed/config and metric definition are explicit.
The leakage variant is detected and preserved as a negative example.
Two same-environment runs reproduce the declared result within the stated tolerance.
The report states that one toy baseline does not establish production or research quality.

triggers: Learner evidence exposes a metric or leakage ambiguity

limitations: Passing the bundled evaluation does not prove learner mastery or model quality.
No Catalyst experiment is created or claimed PASS by this unit.
Transformers, LLMs, Agents and RL/post-training remain downstream topics.
